scope.unverifiedRequirements: The research slice has implementation and API evidence, but does not claim full RP4 release verification: obligation extraction from every asset, source reliability adjudication, conflict/time validity, fact checking, and stale settlement still require end-to-end evidence.

verifiedSlices.result: passed: risk/truth-boundary obligations, sanitized source snapshots, canonicalized tracking-free locators, rights rejection, immutable source/consumption persistence, read-back, conflicting rewrite rejection, API claim assessment, high-risk settlement blocking, source revocation, claim correction, affected-receipt stale propagation, publication-gate blocking, and outline/prose/chapter-settlement/derived-publication write-path enforcement

passed: conflict cases require distinct claims/sources and traceable evidence; resolution can select only a participating claim or explicitly waive with rationale; immutable open cases remain unchanged while resolution events are persisted separately and returned by the API

passed: required primary reliability signals are explicit, copied content is excluded from independent corroboration, independent source IDs are deterministic, and the API returns an auditable eligible/insufficient assessment without changing source authority

passed: fact-checking requires a source-matching evidence anchor and an excerpt present in the frozen sanitized source; missing, mismatched, or unsupported excerpts are blocked and never inferred as supported

passed: high-risk research consumption cannot settle without an explicitly supported fact-check result; missing or blocked fact checks fail closed, while current claims with supported fact checks settle normally
passed: expired/contested claim assessments propagate to all matching consumption receipts, preserve stronger prior stale decisions such as source revocation, and do not touch unrelated receipts

verification.targetedTests: passed: researchGrounding 17/17; researchConflict 3/3; researchReliability 3/3; researchFactCheck 2/2; app suite 151/151 including research-source, reliability, fact-check, high-risk settlement, stale propagation, claim, conflict adjudication, consumption, correction, revocation, publication-gate and adoption enforcement tests
verification.appSuite: 2 unrelated existing tests intermittently failed with fetch bad-port during full app-suite parallel lifecycle; the same suite has passed fully in prior runs and the new targeted tests pass
notYetProven: obligation extraction from every asset and research propagation coverage at full-project scale
publication integration with any future write path not covered by current outline/prose/chapter-settlement/derived-publication routes

nextGate: Run the RP4 phase acceptance against the full 83-requirement profile; retain RP4 as unverified until complete implementation, author and release evidence exists.
